text:
```yaml
name: Debug OCI
on:
  push:
    branches: [ develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ develop ]
jobs:
  debug-oci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Setup Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: '3.0'
        bundler-cache: true
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '18'
        cache: 'pnpm'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pnpm install
        bundle install
    - name: Run E2E tests
      run: |
        pnpm run playwright
      env:
        CI: true
    - name: Run tryouts
      run: |
        pnpm run test:tryouts:agent
      env:
        CI: true
    - name: Validate database cleaner script
      run: |
        ruby .github/scripts/clean_databases.rb --help
```
